The town

Coming to New York to ride?

New York City is the largest city in the United States, with about 8.8 million people across five boroughs. The TD Five Boro Bike Tour starts at Bowling Green at the southern tip of Manhattan on the first Sunday in May and is the one day a year 40 miles of city streets and bridges are closed to cars. Riders base themselves in the Financial District, a short roll from the start.
